parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The names of the devices to which you want to send messages.

> - This parameter is used together with **ProductKey**. The specified devices must belong to the same product.
- You can specify up to 100 device names in a single call. Device names cannot be duplicate.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: MessageContent
parameters.description:
The message body. The maximum size is 256 KB.

You must convert the original message into binary data and then perform Base64 encoding to generate the message body.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which you want to send messages.

parameters.name: Qos
parameters.description:
The quality of service (QoS) level of the message. Valid values:

- **0**: The message is sent at most once.
- **1**: The message is sent at least once.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value **0** is used.

> Messages with QoS=1 can be retained on IoT Platform for up to 7 days. IoT Platform does not retain messages with QoS=0.

parameters.name: TopicShortName
parameters.description:
The suffix of the custom topic.
The custom topic is in the format of `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/${TopicShortName}`. Specify the suffix ${TopicShortName}.

> The specified topic must have the Subscribe permission or the Publish and Subscribe permission, and all devices must have subscribed to the topic.

You can view custom topics by using the following methods:
- On the product details page, click the **Topic Categories** tab to view the custom topics of the product.
- On the device details page, click the **Topic List** tab to view the custom topics to which the device has subscribed.
- Call the [QueryProductTopic](~~69647~~) operation to query the custom topics of the product.
